newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - GCorvi started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GCorvi started at buy.

text.p: -- Valores Finamex initiated grocery distributor GCorvi with buy, saying it has outperformed the IPC index by 30 pct since went public on May 8. Said stock remains "significantly undervalued" compared with main peer Grupo Casa Autrey. Corvi trades at discounts of 55 pct and 42 pct to Autrey, based on price/earnings for 1996 and 1997, respectively.
-- Analyst Francisco Rivero said stock also shows deep discounts against four largest Mexican retail chains.
